justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: Moderate — opens informatics/integration interviews but typically must be paired with hands-on API or EHR project work to convert.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: High — ONC Cures Act mandates FHIR R4 in certified EHRs, so Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth, and payers explicitly seek FHIR-fluent staff.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: Meaningful — interop analyst roles ($85k-$130k) typically exceed bedside PT compensation, especially with 2-3 years industry tenure.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Moderate — covers RESTful APIs, resources, profiles, and terminology binding but does not substitute for software engineering depth.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: Good for clinicians — emphasizes clinical-data modeling where domain knowledge of workflows and documentation is an asset.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Very high — ~$200 exam, self-paced study, no employer sponsorship or prerequisite required, completable in weeks.
